note: Readable definitions for the straight-through predicates, the controls and the terms used by the profile packs. This is configuration, not logic: the engine's rules are in code, and tests/test_library.py fails if this file and the code disagree. Wording is a first draft for the bank's SMEs to validate against their process.

stp_rules.ALLOWED: May go straight through when all 8 predicates hold and the bank's policy allows it.
stp_rules.POLICY_GATED: Goes straight through only if the bank has opted in for this profile; otherwise a person approves.
stp_rules.NEVER: Never goes straight through. No bank setting can loosen this; a person always decides.

approval_paths.MAKER_CHECKER: One person prepares the repair and a different approver releases it.
approval_paths.COMPLIANCE_THEN_RISK: A compliance approver decides first, then a risk approver confirms.

authority_domains.ACCOUNT_OWNERSHIP_BALANCE: The account holder's bank is the authority for who owns an account and what it holds.
authority_domains.CLEARING_SETTLEMENT_STATUS: The clearing or settlement system is the authority for where a payment stands.
authority_domains.LEGAL_PROHIBITION: The sanctions list or legal order is the authority; the bank cannot override it by policy.
authority_domains.QUEUE_PROCESSING_STATE: The bank's own processing queue is the authority for the state of a message in flight.

outcomes.REPAIR: PeX proposes a repair and a resolver works out the new value.
outcomes.DECISION_SUPPORT: PeX gathers the evidence and a person chooses; PeX never picks an option.
outcomes.INVESTIGATION: A tracked investigation, for example funds held at a correspondent.

effects.PROCEED: Clears the case for approval or release.
effects.STOP: Closes the case with no release.
effects.ESCALATE: Hands the case to a senior desk.
effects.HOLD: The case stays open while information or an investigation is outstanding.

evidence_tiers.1: Core record: the bank's own system of record.
evidence_tiers.2: Authoritative external source or the bank's reference data.
evidence_tiers.4: Advisory: informs a person, never proves on its own.

stp_predicates.name: Evidence is sufficient
stp_predicates.meaning: Every mandatory evidence item for the profile is present, fresh and not in conflict.
stp_predicates.fed_by: The profile's evidence contract and the sufficiency check.

stp_predicates.name: Resolution is determined
stp_predicates.meaning: A resolver derived a candidate repair deterministically (no guesswork).

stp_predicates.name: Resolution is unique
stp_predicates.meaning: Exactly one candidate repair exists. Two or more means a person must choose.

stp_predicates.name: Deterministic validation passed
stp_predicates.meaning: The candidate keeps the payment intact (lossless) and passes format and checksum rules.
stp_predicates.fed_by: The resolver's validation of the candidate.

stp_predicates.name: Authority validated
stp_predicates.meaning: The authoritative source for the profile's authority domain confirmed the candidate.
stp_predicates.fed_by: The authority validation, using the profile's authority domain.

stp_predicates.name: Bank policy allows
stp_predicates.meaning: The amount is within the bank's limit and below the dual-authorisation threshold, the currency is an allowed corridor, and straight-through is switched on.

stp_predicates.name: Compliance gate passed
stp_predicates.meaning: Screening returned no sanctions or AML hit; any hit stops straight-through.

stp_predicates.name: Execution preconditions satisfied
stp_predicates.meaning: The payment can be executed now: cutoff still open, ledger reachable, idempotency secured.

controls.name: All 8 predicates must hold
controls.meaning: A case goes straight through only when all 8 predicates are true. One false predicate sends it to a person.

controls.name: AI confidence has no authority
controls.meaning: The AI's confidence score is shown to people but is never one of the 8 predicates and cannot release a payment.
controls.relation_note: States what is not one of the 8: the AI's confidence score. It is the same rule, read from the other side.

controls.name: Straight-through ceiling per profile
controls.meaning: Each profile is marked ALLOWED, POLICY_GATED or NEVER. A bank can tighten this but cannot loosen a NEVER.

controls.name: Missing or conflicting evidence stops release
controls.meaning: If mandatory evidence is missing, stale, or sources contradict each other, the case goes to a person. The engine does not guess.
controls.relation_note: This is the evidence rule behind predicate E_suff. It also applies when a person decides and on profiles that never go straight through.

controls.name: Evidence must meet its required trust tier
controls.meaning: Each evidence item must come from a source at or above the trust tier the profile requires. A weaker source does not count as evidence.
controls.relation_note: The trust-tier minimum is checked inside the evidence-sufficiency rule (E_suff). It also applies when a person decides.

controls.name: Evidence trust tiers
controls.meaning: Each evidence item has a trust tier from 1 (core record) to 4 (advisory). A bank's published configuration may override the defaults.
controls.relation_note: The bank's published configuration sets the trust tiers that CTL-05 enforces.

controls.name: Decision support never picks an option
controls.meaning: For decision-support profiles PeX gathers evidence and shows options, and a named reviewer chooses. PeX never chooses.

controls.name: Separation of duties
controls.meaning: The person who prepared a repair cannot approve it.

controls.name: Approval path per profile
controls.meaning: Each profile names how a case is approved when it is not straight through: maker-checker, compliance then risk, or a single approver.

controls.name: Dual authorisation above a threshold
controls.meaning: Amounts at or above the bank's threshold need two different approvers.
controls.relation_note: For straight-through, the dual-authorisation threshold is part of predicate P_bank. It also forces two approvers when a person decides.

controls.name: One-click batch approval limit
controls.meaning: Validated micro-repairs under the bank's limit can be approved together by a person on the Batches screen.

controls.name: Operation mode
controls.meaning: SHADOW sends nothing to the bank. ASSISTED needs a named person for every handoff. LIVE needs a person or an approved straight-through policy. Changing mode needs two administrators.

controls.name: Signed, idempotent bank callbacks
controls.meaning: A bank outcome is accepted only with a valid signature, and a repeated callback is ignored.

controls.name: PeX never moves money
controls.meaning: PeX hands a decision to the bank's systems, which execute it. PeX holds no funds and sends no payment itself.

controls.name: Tamper-evident audit trail
controls.meaning: Every step is recorded in a SHA-256 hash chain; any change to a past record breaks the chain and is detected.

controls.name: Personal data is tokenised
controls.meaning: Names and account numbers are replaced by tokens outside the evidence zone.

controls.name: Release mode
controls.meaning: The bank chooses who releases cases that pass all 8 predicates: auto-release (eligible cases up to the zero-touch limit, no trigger built yet), approve all in one click, or review each case. A mode never loosens a rule: a case that fails a predicate, or a profile marked never straight through, always goes to a person.
